name: Frederick
source:
The head of the knights who protect Asgard. Though he can be rather rigid, his abilities and character make him an exemplary knight. He is the eldest son of a noble family, but has a strained relationship with his household.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664240/Norns_Dine/]Steam[/url]]
